units.source_text: 父亲大概是想让我看看他利用自己的面子，可以免费入内参观。

en.t: My father probably wanted to show me that, by using his personal connections, he could go inside and visit for free.

units.source_text: 但售票和售护符的人以及在门口检票的人全都变换了，已经不是十几年前父亲常来时的老相识了。

en.t: But the people selling tickets and protective amulets, as well as the people checking tickets at the gate, had all changed; they were no longer the old acquaintances from the days more than ten years earlier when my father often came there.
